text: DSH Approval Notify 是面向 DSH Web 的会话提醒插件，通过订阅会话列表和统一状态流，提示等待审批、提问、计划审核及后台会话完成。浏览器允许原生通知时使用系统通知；权限不可用或创建失败时显示可堆叠的页面 toast。点击通知或 toast 可请求打开对应会话，并对重复请求去重。适合需要及时发现 DSH 会话待处理事项的 Web 用户；需要 DSH 0.2 状态接口及浏览器通知权限（权限未授予时仍可使用 toast）。

DSH Approval Notify alerts DSH Web users about approvals, questions, plan reviews, and completed sessions. It watches session status, deduplicates requests, and prefers browser notifications with page toasts as fallback. Activating an alert opens its session. Requires the DSH 0.2 status API.
想在 DSH Web 里及时看到等待我审批的会话。
有新的问题或计划审核时，能不能提醒我？
后台会话结束后给我一个浏览器通知。
浏览器通知不可用时，希望页面里还能弹出提醒。
Notify me when a DSH session is waiting for approval or an answer.
Show an alert when a background session finishes, with a way to reopen it.
DSH Approval Notify 功能「待处理事项提醒」：DSH 状态出现审批、提问或计划审核请求时，插件按请求类型生成提醒，并用请求 key 去重；相同请求的重复状态更新不会反复通知。
DSH Approval Notify 功能「原生通知与页面 toast」：状态变化时优先尝试浏览器原生通知；权限未授予、接口不可用或创建失败时，改为显示可堆叠的页面 toast。
DSH Approval Notify feature “Open session”: Activate an alert to open its session; toasts also support Enter and Space.
@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify 的维护与更新元数据：已归档；距最后推送 10 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 22/100（置信度 low）。

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · @whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A minimal browser-only DSH Web GUI plugin that reminds you when a session needs attention or a background session finishes.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · @whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify：Version 0.2.1 targets DSH **0.2.1-alpha.1**. It reads labels from `sessions.list` and attention state from the public `uiSession.sessionStatus` observable: `pendingInteraction` for approval/question/plan review and `completionUnread` for background completion. It prefers native browser notifications, and falls back to a larger stacked toast panel when native notifications are unavailable. On Windows, granted browser notifications surface through the system notification center.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · What it notifies：| DSH state | Notification title | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval` | Approval request | The session is waiting for an approval decision. |
| `question` | Question request | The session is waiting for a user choice or answer. |
| `plan-review` | Plan review | The session is waiting for plan confirmation. |
| `completed` | Completed | A top-level background session has finished. |
| `completed` on a subagent | Subagent completed | A subagent/background child session has finished. |

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Highlights：- Browser-only; the host half is intentionally empty.
- Watches the live DSH session list and unified session-status feed; no dependency on `dsh-web-ui-all`.
- Uses the public `sessions`, `uiSession`, and `uiWorkspace` Client services; no DOM queries of core page structure.
- Opens the corresponding session when a native notification or fallback toast is clicked; the toast also supports Enter and Space. Window activation is subject to browser, desktop application, and OS policy.
- Responds to store subscriptions without fixed-interval polling; relies on DSH to publish updates and replay pending requests on reconnect.
- Uses native browser notifications first, with `requireInteraction: true`.
- Falls back to a larger right-bottom toast panel when native notifications fail.
- Supports multiple stacked fallback toasts.
- Deduplicates unchanged requests by their opaque key and unread completions by state; another request or a later completion can notify again.
- Does not treat idle historical sessions as newly completed; the main-view session follows DSH's completion acknowledgement policy.
- Keeps deduplication, timers, and toast clean

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/whoisDDD/dsh-approval-notify.git
cd dsh-approval-notify
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

After installation, restart `dsh web` and reload the DSH Web GUI page. The browser may ask for notification permission on first load. While permission is ungranted, the plugin immediately shows in-page toast reminders, even if the permission prompt never settles. Native notification creation failures also fall back to toast.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Desktop and Web profiles：DSH Desktop has its own `desktop` profile; installing the plugin into the `web` profile does not automatically change Desktop. In DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 and 0.2.2-alpha.2, their default directories are `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` and `~/.dsh/profiles/web`; a `DSH_HOME` set for the desktop process changes the root. Start Desktop at least once to initialize its profile, then fully quit Desktop and its Host before using `dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<absolute-plugin-path>`. Preserve existing profile backups and make sure the CLI and Desktop use the same user and DSH_HOME. Restart Desktop and verify the startup log and served JavaScript.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm test

Useful scripts:

- `pnpm test` — run all Vitest tests (build first after changing source). Includes the shipped bundle against the published DSH UiSession service, with fixture remote events; no provider API calls.
- `pnpm test:notify` — run the core notification behavior tests.
- `pnpm typecheck` — run TypeScript type checking.
- `pnpm build` — generate `lib/` artifacts.
- `pnpm watch` — rebuild the client bundle during development.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Development：The startup log is `[approval-notify] loaded (session-navigation, event-driven)`. A native click logs `native notification clicked`, followed by `session navigation requested` after the host navigation call returns. These logs omit session titles and IDs; a returned call does not guarantee that the UI switched or its window gained focus. If the old `loaded` log persists, inspect the actual Host/profile and loaded plugin rather than relying on source-map line numbers alone.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Development：`.gitattributes` keeps TypeScript sources and generated bundles at LF so Windows checkouts do not embed CRLF in source maps. Existing working trees may need affected files checked out again after updating; preserve any local changes first.

@whoisddd/dsh-approval-notify README · Notes and limitations：- This plugin does not implement a settings UI yet.
- Notification delivery depends on browser permission and the operating system notification policy.
- Notification clicks require the originating page to remain alive; archived or unavailable sessions may not open. Window activation on Windows and Linux browsers and desktop applications requires platform-specific testing.
- In one Windows 10 22H2 / DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 test, clicking a question notification selected the source session, but a minimized window did not restore automatically; the selected session was visible after manual restoration. Window activation depends on the host and OS and is not guaranteed.
- The same device run did not complete approval, plan review, fallback toast, background completion, or reconnect regression; Linux and browser window activation remain unverified on real devices. Automatic review that immediately handles a request may leave no pending request to notify.
- Requires the DSH 0.2 unified status API. DSH 0.1.2-alpha.2 is no longer supported by this release. The removed `SessionSummary.completed` and `uiSession.pendingInteractions`
